crossRefs.note: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here…
While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you destroy all…
Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood…
The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Yahweh.
You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might…
However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly.
Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.
Don’t you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
“Many nations will pass by this city, and they will each ask his neighbor, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this great…
Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh their God, worshiped other gods, and served…
“Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as it is today; to the men of Judah, and to the…
Therefore Yahweh has watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for Yahweh our God is righteous in all his works…
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…
For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”

translations.web: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord Yahweh.
translations.bsb: They will bring you consolation when you see their conduct and actions, and you will know that it was not without cause that I have done all these things within it,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
translations.kjv: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their way and their doings; and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord Jehovah.
